title: Rewiring protein binding specificity in paralogous DRG/DFRP complexes
authors: Christian A. E. Westrip; Stephen J Smerdon; Mathew L. Coleman
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AlphaFold结构模型和生化突变分析研究旁系同源DRG/DFRP蛋白复合物的结合特异性重编程，虽为蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，但其基于结构预测的界面残基特异性解析方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合特异性研究。
abstract: The Developmentally Regulated GTP-binding (DRG) proteins are an ancient subfamily of GTPases implicated in the regulation of translation and cell growth. In eukaryotes, there are two paralogs: DRG1 and DRG2, both of which have a conserved binding partner called DRG family regulatory protein 1 and 2 (DFRP1 and DFRP2), respectively. These binding partners are required for the function of DRGs, including their stabilisation at the protein level. Moreover, DFRPs interact with their respective DRG via a conserved region called the DFRP domain. Despite being highly similar, DRG1 and DRG2 have strict binding specificity for their respective DFRP. Using AlphaFold generated structure models of the human DRG/DFRP complexes, we have biochemically characterised their interactions and identified interface residues involved in determining specificity. This analysis revealed that as few as five mutations in DRG1 are able to switch its binding from DFRP1 to DFRP2. We show how two DRG1 residues in the core of the interface are most important for specifying the interaction with DFRP1 over DFRP2. We also demonstrate that whilst DFRP1 can stimulate the GTPase activity of DRG1, DFRP2 binding cannot. Overall, this work provides new insight into the structural determinants responsible for the binding specificities of the DRG:DFRP translation factor complexes, which are known to be essential for normal development in mice and humans.
abstract_zh: 发育调控性GTP结合（DRG）蛋白是GTP酶的一个古老亚家族，参与调控翻译和细胞生长。在真核生物中，存在两个旁系同源物：DRG1和DRG2，它们各自有一个保守的结合伴侣，分别称为DRG家族调控蛋白1和2（DFRP1和DFRP2）。这些结合伴侣是DRG功能所必需的，包括其在蛋白质水平上的稳定性。此外，DFRP通过一个称为DFRP结构域的保守区域与其相应的DRG相互作用。尽管DRG1和DRG2高度相似，但它们对其各自的DFRP具有严格的结合特异性。利用AlphaFold生成的人DRG/DFRP复合物结构模型，我们在生化层面表征了它们的相互作用，并鉴定了决定特异性的界面残基。该分析揭示，DRG1中仅需五个突变即可将其结合从DFRP1切换至DFRP2。我们展示了界面核心中的两个DRG1残基对于优先与DFRP1而非DFRP2相互作用最为关键。我们还证明，虽然DFRP1能刺激DRG1的GTP酶活性，但DFRP2结合则不能。总体而言，这项工作为DRG:DFRP翻译因子复合物结合特异性的结构决定因素提供了新见解，这些复合物已知对小鼠和人类的正常发育至关重要。
